results.original: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.
results.reconstruction: A small transformer uses self attention to process text and employs backpropagation during the training period to improve predictions of the small transformer. Regularization enables generalization capability of the small transformer beyond its training examples, while quantization reduces memory requirements of the small transformer after training. Retrieval augmented generation lets the small transformer use external documents when answering questions.
results.reason: The text was constructed by sequentially combining the supplied relations in their source occurrence order. Each sentence aggregates related predicates (e.g., 'uses', 'employs_backpropagation_for_training') associated with the 'small transformer' subject, preserving specific conditions like 'during training period' and 'after training'. The final sentence incorporates the distinct capability enabled by 'retrieval augmented generation'. All argument qualifiers were integrated as descriptive clauses to maintain fidelity to the source data without inferring additional facts.
